dedupe_keys.name: elcom sunshine electricity network efficiency and reliability indicators

description: ElCom’s Sunshine collection publishes indicators for comparing Swiss electricity distribution operators. The official registry describes efficiency and price-trend indicators, and the public portal includes supply-reliability measures such as SAIDI and SAIFI. Four registry products expose operator indicators, category breakdowns and their corresponding medians; this record covers that named family. Registry temporal coverage is 2024–2026, while the exact observation year differs by indicator and should be checked before joining series. Data are public through portal exports and linked-data SPARQL distributions under the Swiss Open use terms, which allow commercial and non-commercial reuse with recommended attribution. A limitation is that public reliability comparisons cover only larger operators in the inspected map, leaving other service areas uncoloured. Aggregate indicators also do not identify individual outages, restoration trajectories or failure causes. Simulation uses include comparing distribution-system reliability and calibrating service-performance targets. No matching catalogue or first-review draft was found. The separate ElCom tariff collection provides annual prices, not this performance family. No CSV exports or SPARQL data payloads were retrieved.
